Sunny Moon Village

Villa in Nai Harn
HomeSaleSunny Moon Village

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A gated community of single-storey villas in Nai Harn from Sunny Development Group, with 2, 3 and 4 bedroom homes of about 149 to 215 sqm. Each villa has its own pool and sunrise-facing orientation, and residents share the wellness and sports amenities of the neighbouring Sunny Moon project.

Sunny Moon Village: key facts

  • Sunny Moon Village is a pool villa in Nai Harn, Phuket, developed by Sunny Development Group.
  • Units: 2–4 bedrooms, 149–215 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿12,243,000.
  • Nearest beach: Nai Harn Beach (2.2 km (3-4 min by car per developer presentation), driving).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Nai Harn Beach (2.2 km (3-4 min by car per developer presentation), driving).
